en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the grounds of a Catholic educational institute with a fenced tennis court in the foreground and a winding path leading through gardens toward hillside villas and school buildings. Printed Hungarian text at the top identifies the Marianum Roman Catholic teaching and educational institute run by the Sisters of Our Lady and notes the institutional tennis court, with the city name Kolozsvár emphasized.
